briefs.brief_cn: Toast 的核心卡点在于餐厅 POS、支付、订阅软件、营销、排班/工资、库存和客户触达形成的一体化经营系统。事实层面，Toast 在 2026 年一季度披露 ARR 同比增长 26% 至 22 亿美元，地点数约 17.1 万个，GPV 同比增长 22% 至 513 亿美元，并上调 2026 年非 GAAP 订阅服务和金融科技解决方案毛利、调整后 EBITDA 指引。推论是：如果餐厅继续面对人工、获客和菜单价格压力，Toast 的价值不只是收单，而是成为提升坪效、复购和运营效率的“餐厅操作系统”。需要验证的关键缺口是净收入留存、模块 attach rate、流失率、细分餐饮客户健康度，以及 AI/营销/工资等增购是否真实拉动单位经济。若地点增长放缓、GPV/地点下滑、软件 attach 停滞、流失率上升或支付 take rate 承压，则应下调该卡点 thesis。
briefs.brief_en: Toast’s chokepoint is the integrated restaurant operating layer: POS, payments, subscription software, marketing, labor/payroll, inventory, and guest engagement. As reported in Q1 2026, Toast grew ARR 26% year over year to $2.2 billion, reached about 171,000 locations, grew GPV 22% to $51.3 billion, and raised 2026 guidance for non-GAAP subscription and fintech gross profit and adjusted EBITDA. The inference is that under persistent labor, demand-generation, and pricing pressure, Toast can become more than a payments vendor: it can function as the operating system that improves throughput, guest retention, and management efficiency. The main evidence gap is whether net revenue retention, module attach rates, churn, segment-level restaurant health, and AI/marketing/payroll adoption prove durable expansion rather than cyclical software spend. The thesis would weaken if location adds slow sharply, GPV per location declines, attach rates stall, churn rises, or payments economics compress.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Toast is a high-purity public-market proxy for the restaurant operating-system chokepoint, combining POS, payments, software modules, data, and guest-demand tools into a platform that may become more mission-critical as restaurant operators seek productivity and demand capture.
evidence_to_verify: Q1 2026 ARR, location count, GPV, gross profit, adjusted EBITDA, and 2026 guidance from Toast Form 8-K / earnings release.
Latest 10-Q and earnings-call commentary on net revenue retention, churn, same-location GPV, and module attach rates.
Adoption data for marketing, payroll, inventory, loyalty, Toast IQ Grow, drive-thru, and enterprise accounts.
Restaurant operator health indicators by segment: SMB, enterprise, full-service, QSR, retail/food-and-beverage, and international.
falsification: Net location additions slow materially for multiple quarters.
GPV growth is driven mainly by inflation while GPV per location or transaction activity weakens.
Subscription attach rates and recurring gross profit growth decelerate faster than location growth.
Churn rises among independent restaurants or enterprise implementations fail to scale.
Competitive pricing pressure from Square, Clover, PAR, Oracle, NCR Voyix, or in-house enterprise systems compresses margins.
monitoring_items: ARR growth and split between payments ARR and subscription ARR.
Total locations, net adds, and customer mix.
GPV growth versus same-location transaction growth and restaurant inflation.
Recurring gross profit growth and non-GAAP subscription/fintech gross profit margin.
Attach rates for payroll, marketing, loyalty, inventory, ordering, and AI products.
Customer wins/losses in enterprise and international markets.

briefs.brief_cn: 麦当劳的卡点不是单一餐厅，而是全球 QSR 体系中的低价流量、数字会员、菜单创新、早餐/饮料和加盟商单位经济组合。事实层面，麦当劳 2026 年一季度披露全球可比销售增长 3.8%，美国可比销售增长 3.9%，并表示全球各分部均实现稳健可比增长；2025 年报/全年业绩披露 70 个会员市场全年会员系统销售额接近 370 亿美元，90 日活跃会员接近 2.1 亿。推论是：在消费者追求性价比、低收入客群承压的环境中，麦当劳可用规模采购、营销、会员和促销分摊能力验证大型 QSR 是否能守住客流。关键风险是增长可能更多来自客单价而非客流，且价值菜单可能侵蚀加盟商利润。若促销只能换来短期 check 增长、客流持续下滑、加盟商现金流恶化或国际市场失速，则 thesis 应降级。
briefs.brief_en: McDonald’s chokepoint is the global QSR value-traffic system: affordability, digital loyalty, menu innovation, breakfast/beverages, scale marketing, and franchisee unit economics. In Q1 2026, McDonald’s reported global comparable sales growth of 3.8% and U.S. comparable sales growth of 3.9%, with solid comparable sales growth across all segments. Its 2025 annual/full-year disclosure showed loyalty systemwide sales across 70 loyalty markets approaching $37 billion and 90-day active loyalty users near 210 million at year-end. The inference is that McDonald’s can test whether scaled QSR systems can protect traffic in a value-seeking consumer environment through scale, loyalty, marketing, and promotion funding. The main risk is that growth may be check-driven rather than traffic-driven, and value promotions may pressure franchisee economics. The thesis weakens if promotions produce only temporary average-check gains, traffic keeps falling, franchisee cash flow deteriorates, or international momentum fades.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: McDonald’s is the benchmark public-market node for value-led QSR demand aggregation, loyalty-driven traffic retention, and franchise-system resilience under pressured consumer spending.
evidence_to_verify: Q1 2026 comparable sales by segment, especially U.S. comparable sales and whether growth came from check, traffic, or mix.
Latest loyalty disclosures: 90-day active users, loyalty sales, frequency, and digital penetration.
Franchisee cash flow, restaurant margin dollars, value-menu funding, and promotion burden sharing.
International operated and developmental licensed market performance.
falsification: Comparable sales remain positive but are primarily price/check-driven while guest counts decline.
Value promotions require rising corporate subsidy or damage franchisee margins.
Loyalty sales grow but do not improve frequency, traffic, or value perception.
International market comps weaken or unit development slows.
Consumer backlash on affordability persists despite menu/value actions.
monitoring_items: U.S. traffic versus average check contribution.
Global comparable sales by segment.
90-day active loyalty users and loyalty systemwide sales.
Franchisee cash flow and restaurant margin dollars.
Value-menu funding, discount intensity, and promotional cadence.
Breakfast, beverage, and chicken/menu innovation performance.

briefs.brief_cn: Sysco 的卡点在于餐饮供应链中的广域补货、采购规模、品类管理、冷链/物流密度和独立餐厅服务能力。事实层面，Sysco 2026 财年三季度销售额同比增长 4.7% 至 205 亿美元，毛利率提升 31 个基点至 18.6%；美国 Foodservice 总箱量增长 2.3%，本地箱量增长 3.3%；公司还宣布拟收购 Jetro Restaurant Depot，目标加强对小型独立餐厅和企业客户的覆盖。推论是：在餐厅成本压力较高时，分销商的采购、私有品牌、菜单成本支持和配送密度可能成为独立餐厅存活与优化的重要节点。若箱量增长放缓、毛利率改善来自不可持续通胀传导、私有品牌渗透下降、客户流失或 Jetro 交易受阻，则 thesis 下降。
briefs.brief_en: Sysco’s chokepoint is broadline foodservice distribution: replenishment scale, sourcing, category management, cold-chain/logistics density, private-label options, and independent-restaurant reach. In fiscal Q3 2026, Sysco reported sales growth of 4.7% to $20.5 billion, gross margin expansion of 31 basis points to 18.6%, U.S. Foodservice case growth of 2.3%, and local case growth of 3.3%. Sysco also announced an agreement to acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot, which would expand access to smaller independent restaurants and businesses, subject to regulatory review. The inference is that when operators face food-cost and margin pressure, distributors with procurement scale, private-label alternatives, menu-cost support, and delivery density can become more valuable. The thesis weakens if case growth slows, margin expansion proves inflation/pass-through dependent, private-label penetration falls, customer retention weakens, or the Jetro transaction is blocked or fails to integrate.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Sysco is a major upstream restaurant health and procurement-efficiency node, with potential leverage to independent-restaurant consolidation, purchasing optimization, and distributor-led cost control.
evidence_to_verify: Fiscal Q3 2026 sales, gross margin, U.S. Foodservice case growth, and local case growth.
Independent-restaurant customer retention and local customer case growth.
Sysco Brand/private-label sales as a percentage of cases and category margin mix.
Inflation/deflation pass-through by dairy, meat, seafood, and other major categories.
Regulatory status and integration plan for the Jetro Restaurant Depot acquisition.
falsification: Local and independent-restaurant case growth turns negative.
Gross margin improvement reverses as inflation normalizes or price competition increases.
Private-label penetration declines or fails to support customer savings.
Operating expense growth offsets gross profit gains for multiple quarters.
Jetro transaction is blocked, delayed materially, or creates integration/antitrust costs.
monitoring_items: U.S. Foodservice total and local case growth.
Gross margin and product cost inflation/deflation.
Sysco Brand sales as a percentage of cases.
Customer retention and independent-restaurant demand indicators.
Operating expense growth versus volume growth.
Jetro Restaurant Depot regulatory review and expected fiscal 2027 close timing.

briefs.brief_cn: PAR 的卡点在于多门店餐饮品牌的任务关键型软件层：POS、忠诚度、点餐、支付、后台运营、数据和 AI 工作流。事实层面，PAR 2026 年一季度披露收入同比增长 19.4% 至 1.24 亿美元，调整后 EBITDA 约 890 万美元；公司将 KPI 拆分为 Engagement Cloud 和 Operator Cloud，前者 ARR 为 1.983 亿美元、活跃站点 13.9 万个，后者 ARR 为 1.318 亿美元、活跃站点 6.03 万个，并首次给出 2026 年收入和调整后 EBITDA 指引。推论是：PAR 可能是更高弹性的企业餐饮科技纯度标的，但证据质量低于 Toast，因为需要验证收购整合、客户集中度、利润率、产品是否不可替代，以及 AI 是否真正嵌入门店工作流。若 ARR/活跃站点增长减速、订阅毛利率下滑、收购整合失败或客户流失，则 thesis 应明显降级。
briefs.brief_en: PAR’s chokepoint is mission-critical software for multi-unit restaurant and commerce brands: POS, loyalty, ordering, payments, back-office operations, data, and AI workflow orchestration. In Q1 2026, PAR reported revenue growth of 19.4% to $124.0 million and adjusted EBITDA of about $8.9 million. It disclosed Engagement Cloud ARR of $198.3 million with 139.0 thousand active sites and Operator Cloud ARR of $131.8 million with 60.3 thousand active sites, and provided 2026 guidance for the first time. The inference is that PAR offers high-purity exposure to enterprise restaurant technology with potentially more operating leverage, but evidence quality is lower than Toast because acquisition integration, customer concentration, margin trajectory, product indispensability, and AI workflow adoption still require verification. The thesis weakens if ARR or active-site growth slows, subscription gross margin erodes, integrations underperform, or major enterprise customers churn.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: PAR is a focused enterprise restaurant-tech platform that may control high-value workflow chokepoints across POS, loyalty, ordering, payments, data, and back-office operations for multi-unit brands.
evidence_to_verify: Q1 2026 revenue growth, adjusted EBITDA, Engagement Cloud ARR/sites, and Operator Cloud ARR/sites.
Organic versus acquired ARR growth after Punchh, TASK, Plexure, Bridg, and other integrations.
Customer wins/losses in QSR and multi-unit enterprise brands.
Subscription service gross margin trend and operating leverage.
Proof that PAR Intelligence and AI features are embedded in daily workflows rather than optional add-ons.
falsification: ARR growth slows materially after acquisition effects fade.
Active Sites stagnate or decline in either Engagement Cloud or Operator Cloud.
Subscription gross margin continues to compress without clear reinvestment payoff.
Large enterprise customers delay rollouts, switch vendors, or insource systems.
Integration costs, debt, dilution, or acquisition complexity overwhelm operating leverage.
monitoring_items: Engagement Cloud ARR and Active Sites.
Operator Cloud ARR and Active Sites.
Organic ARR growth versus acquisition-driven growth.
Subscription service gross margin percentage.
Adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow trajectory.
Enterprise QSR wins, rollouts, churn, and implementation timelines.
PAR Intelligence adoption and measurable workflow ROI.

briefs.brief_cn: DoorDash 是餐饮外卖需求、配送密度、会员频次和商户数字化变现的关键观察点。卡点假设是：如果消费者仍愿意为便利支付溢价、DashPass 能提高频次并降低流失、商户广告和平台服务能在不明显损害商户经济性的情况下扩张，则 DoorDash 可能成为餐饮非堂食需求的基础设施型节点。现有公开证据显示，2026 年一季度总订单同比增长 27%，美国餐饮品类新消费者和成熟用户订单率均同比增长，DashPass 会员增长和流失改善。但仍需拆分餐饮与杂货、本地商业、Wolt/Deliveroo 等非纯餐饮贡献，核验餐饮 take rate、广告收入占比、商户留存和监管劳工成本影响。
briefs.brief_en: DoorDash is a high-signal node for off-premise restaurant demand, logistics density, subscription-driven frequency, and merchant monetization. The chokepoint hypothesis is that if consumers continue to pay for convenience, DashPass supports repeat ordering and lower churn, and merchant ads/services scale without breaking restaurant economics, DoorDash can function as infrastructure for restaurant demand outside the dining room. Current public evidence shows Q1 2026 total orders grew 27% year over year, U.S. restaurant new consumers and mature-cohort order rates grew year over year, and DashPass member trends improved. The key gap is isolating restaurant delivery from grocery, broader local commerce, Wolt/Deliveroo, and other non-restaurant contributions.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: DoorDash may be a demand-discovery and last-mile density chokepoint for restaurants: it concentrates consumer demand, logistics capacity, membership frequency, and merchant advertising surfaces that individual restaurants may struggle to replicate at scale.
evidence_to_verify: Q1 2026 total orders increased to 933 million, up 27% year over year, per DoorDash Form 10-Q.
Q1 2026 U.S. restaurant category showed year-over-year growth in new consumers and mature-cohort order rates, per DoorDash shareholder materials.
DashPass member growth accelerated in Q1 2026 with stronger sign-ups and reduced churn, per DoorDash shareholder materials.
Verify restaurant-specific GOV, take rate, ads contribution, merchant retention/churn, and order frequency separate from grocery, convenience, Wolt, Deliveroo, and broader local commerce.
falsification: Restaurant-specific order growth decelerates materially while non-restaurant categories drive reported growth.
Merchant churn rises or take-rate/advertising monetization pressures restaurant margins enough to reduce platform participation.
DashPass engagement weakens, member churn rises, or mature-cohort frequency stalls.
Regulatory labor-cost changes materially impair contribution profit or force higher consumer fees that reduce demand.
monitoring_items: Restaurant-only order growth and GOV disclosure, if available
Net revenue margin and contribution profit as a percentage of Marketplace GOV
DashPass member growth, churn, and order frequency
Advertising revenue growth and merchant adoption
Courier labor classification, minimum-pay rules, and fee-cap/regulatory developments
Mix shift between restaurants, grocery, convenience, Wolt, Deliveroo, and other local-commerce categories

briefs.brief_cn: Yum! Brands 是全球加盟制 QSR 系统的关键样本，尤其能观察 Taco Bell 的价值定位、菜单创新、数字化和国际扩张是否能抵消 Pizza Hut 的结构性压力。卡点假设是：Yum 的多品牌、全球加盟、技术平台和门店开发能力构成可复制的 QSR 增长系统。公开证据显示，2026 年一季度全球同店销售增长 3%，系统销售按固定汇率增长 6%，Taco Bell 美国同店销售增长 8%，数字系统销售接近 110 亿美元且占系统销售 63%。但品牌组合复杂，Pizza Hut 疲弱可能稀释 Taco Bell/KFC 的强信号。
briefs.brief_en: Yum! Brands is a global franchised QSR read-through, especially for whether Taco Bell’s value proposition, menu innovation, digital engagement, and international growth can offset structural pressure at Pizza Hut. The chokepoint hypothesis is that Yum’s multi-brand franchise architecture, technology platform, and unit-development engine form a repeatable QSR growth system. Public evidence shows Q1 2026 worldwide same-store sales rose 3%, system sales grew 6% excluding FX, Taco Bell U.S. same-store sales rose 8%, and digital system sales approached $11 billion, representing 63% of system sales. The main complication is brand-mix complexity, with Pizza Hut weakness potentially diluting the Taco Bell/KFC signal.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Yum may be a franchised QSR operating-system chokepoint: brand scale, franchise economics, technology, and global unit development can compound if franchisees continue to earn acceptable returns and digital systems raise throughput and frequency.
evidence_to_verify: Q1 2026 worldwide same-store sales grew 3% and system sales grew 6% excluding foreign exchange.
Taco Bell U.S. same-store sales grew 8% in Q1 2026.
Digital system sales neared $11 billion and reached 63% of system sales in Q1 2026.
Verify Taco Bell versus KFC versus Pizza Hut traffic, franchisee profitability, royalty growth, unit economics, and promotional margin impact.
falsification: Taco Bell comps become primarily price-driven while traffic weakens.
Pizza Hut underperformance consumes management attention or capital and offsets Taco Bell/KFC growth.
Franchisee unit economics deteriorate, slowing net unit growth or increasing closures.
Digital mix grows but fails to improve throughput, labor efficiency, ticket size, or loyalty frequency.
monitoring_items: Brand-level same-store sales and traffic, especially Taco Bell U.S.
Franchisee restaurant-level margins and unit economics
Net unit growth, closures, and remodel requirements
Pizza Hut strategic review and closure cadence
Digital system sales mix, loyalty engagement, drive-thru throughput, and AI/technology rollout
Promotional intensity and value-menu margin impact

briefs.brief_cn: Texas Roadhouse 是休闲餐饮中少数能直接检验正客流、价值感和门店执行力的高纯度样本。卡点假设是：在消费者更谨慎、牛肉和人工成本仍有压力的环境下，Texas Roadhouse 依靠高性价比、门店吞吐、等待需求和稳定执行力，可能继续获得客流份额。公开证据显示，2026 年一季度可比餐厅销售增长 7.1%，其中客流增长 4.5%、平均客单增长 2.6%；餐厅利润率为 16.3%，受 6.2% 商品通胀和 3.8% 工资及其他人工通胀影响。核心验证点是正客流是否能持续，而不是仅靠涨价。
briefs.brief_en: Texas Roadhouse is a high-purity casual-dining test case for positive traffic, value perception, and store-level execution. The chokepoint hypothesis is that in a cautious consumer environment with beef and labor pressure, Texas Roadhouse can continue taking traffic share through perceived value, throughput, wait-list demand, and consistent operations. Public evidence shows Q1 2026 comparable restaurant sales rose 7.1%, driven by 4.5% traffic growth and 2.6% average-check growth; restaurant margin was 16.3%, pressured by 6.2% commodity inflation and 3.8% wage/other labor inflation. The key test is whether traffic remains positive rather than comps being sustained mostly by pricing.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Texas Roadhouse may be a casual-dining demand-share chokepoint: its value perception and operating throughput can attract traffic even when consumers trade down or resist price increases.
evidence_to_verify: Q1 2026 comparable restaurant sales rose 7.1%, with traffic up 4.5% and average check up 2.6%.
Q1 2026 restaurant margin decreased 36 basis points to 16.3%.
Q1 2026 commodity inflation was 6.2%, driven partly by higher beef costs, and wage/other labor inflation was 3.8%.
Verify wait-time data, throughput, guest satisfaction, beef-cost outlook, labor productivity, and whether positive traffic continues after menu-price actions.
falsification: Traffic turns negative while comparable sales depend mostly on pricing.
Beef inflation persists or accelerates enough to compress restaurant margins materially.
Labor inflation and staffing constraints reduce service quality or throughput.
Value perception weakens as menu prices rise relative to QSR and other casual-dining alternatives.
monitoring_items: Traffic versus check split in comparable sales
Beef, commodity, and wage inflation outlook
Restaurant margin and labor percentage of sales
Average weekly sales, table turns, wait times, and throughput metrics
Menu pricing cadence and consumer value scores
New-unit productivity and cannibalization risk

briefs.brief_cn: Chipotle 是高端快休闲的吞吐、数字订单和品牌定价能力基准。卡点假设是：如果 Chipotle 能在不依赖过度涨价的情况下恢复交易量，并通过数字化、设备效率、菜单创新和门店扩张维持利润率，则它仍是快休闲效率模型的代表。但当前证据更偏“需验证”：2026 年一季度收入增长 7.4% 至约 31 亿美元，可比餐厅销售仅增长 0.5%，交易量增长 0.6%、平均客单下降 0.1%，数字销售占食品饮料收入 38.6%。这说明交易量回正但增速较低，市场需验证其高估值质量是否仍由真实流量支撑。
briefs.brief_en: Chipotle is a benchmark for premium fast-casual throughput, digital ordering, and brand pricing power. The chokepoint hypothesis is that if Chipotle can restore transaction growth without relying excessively on price, while using digital systems, equipment efficiency, menu innovation, and unit growth to protect margins, it remains a leading fast-casual operating model. Current evidence is more mixed: Q1 2026 revenue rose 7.4% to about $3.1 billion, comparable restaurant sales increased only 0.5%, transactions rose 0.6%, average check declined 0.1%, and digital sales represented 38.6% of food and beverage revenue. The key question is whether quality is still supported by real traffic rather than historical reputation and valuation premium.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Chipotle may be a premium fast-casual throughput chokepoint: brand, kitchen process, digital ordering, and high-unit-volume economics can create a scalable restaurant model if transaction growth and margins recover together.
evidence_to_verify: Q1 2026 revenue rose 7.4% to approximately $3.1 billion.
Q1 2026 comparable restaurant sales increased 0.5%, driven by transactions up 0.6% and average check down 0.1%.
Q1 2026 digital sales represented 38.6% of total food and beverage revenue.
Verify labor productivity, restaurant-level margin, protein/input inflation, digital order accuracy, throughput initiatives, loyalty engagement, and 2026 comparable-sales guidance.
falsification: Transaction growth falls back into negative territory or remains too weak to support unit economics.
Comparable sales rely mainly on price while traffic and value perception deteriorate.
Digital mix stays high but creates order-accuracy, throughput, or guest-satisfaction problems.
Protein, wage, or freight inflation compresses restaurant margins faster than productivity initiatives can offset.
monitoring_items: Traffic versus price/check split in comparable sales
Restaurant-level operating margin and labor productivity
Digital sales mix, order accuracy, app/loyalty engagement, and delivery aggregator mix
Throughput metrics and high-efficiency equipment rollout
Food inflation, especially beef, chicken, avocado, dairy, and freight
New restaurant openings, average unit volumes, and returns on new units

summary: Split Layer 4 briefs merged from ranked-candidate chunks.
